verdict.rationale: Pomelo's docs say clients can issue batches (lotes) of innominate cards, which Pomelo ships and stores with its logistics partner. That is a first-party bulk operation, but it covers only one narrow item type and one action. The MCP server (pomelo-docs-20, pomelo-docs-21) only searches endpoints and generates code; it does not run bulk operations. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints across item types (users, cards, accounts, transactions), bulk update/delete operations, programmatic or agent-driven batch execution details, and independent corroboration.
